caption: The drawing depicts a six-pronged fishing spear (also known as a gig or trident) with a central shaft and six outwardly curved metal tines, each ending in a pointed tip with backward-facing barbs near the end. The spear is colored in various shades of brown and dark rust, giving the appearance of aged and possibly corroded metal. The base of the spearhead appears to be fitted with a short section of wooden handle, which is partially encased in a dark metal sleeve. The entire object is centered vertically on a plain, light beige background, with no additional objects or features present in the composition. A small signature or inscription is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Fishing Spear
